_doc: PLATFORM ADAPTER: only the limits of a destination. It is data, not strategy: swap or add a file per platform. Values marked verified were read from LinkedIn's own help page on the date below. Anything not stated by LinkedIn is listed under `not_stated` and must not be assumed.
placement: Sponsored Content video ad (PAID feed). Organic Page video has separate limits under `organic`.

sources: https://www.linkedin.com/help/lms/answer/a424737 (Video ads advertising specifications; page said 'Last updated: 2 months ago')

video.fps_rule: PAID ads: LinkedIn's video-ads spec says 'Less than 30 FPS' (V), confirmed by the studio owner's own paid-ad experience. ORGANIC Page video accepts 10-60 FPS (V, see `organic`). Studio policy: masters stay 60 fps; a PAID export is converted to `fps_paid_export` by frame BLENDING; organic keeps the master's rate.

duration_s.recommended_why: LinkedIn: '15-30 seconds long, so they can qualify for all possible placements'

1:1.recommended_note: LinkedIn lists no recommended size for 1:1; 1080x1080 is our choice within its min/max

audio.note: LinkedIn lists 'AAC or MPEG4' and 'Less than 64KHz' (as written). We use AAC 44.1 kHz stereo.

video.fps_paid_export_why: satisfies both 'less than 30' (LinkedIn's page) and '30 or less' (owner's wording); visually identical to 30

introductory_text.note: up to 10 emojis; URLs over 23 chars are shortened

headline.note: recommended length avoids truncation on most devices

guidance.rule: Short videos are more likely to be watched to completion: LinkedIn data (2025) reports 7-15 s videos with up to a 300% lift in completion rates.
guidance.note: LinkedIn's own statistic; for demand generation LinkedIn says longer content performed equivalently to shorter videos

guidance.rule: 'Establish your point in the first 5 seconds, then drive it home'; 'show what you want your audience to see in the first 10 seconds'.
'Think like a silent film director': a large portion of members watch with sound off; consider burning in subtitles.
Feature a clear CTA so the audience knows how to act.
In-stream placements may not always include a CTA; on mobile the landing page shows below the video for website visit/conversion objectives.

ad_formats_seen: Search summaries of LinkedIn's pages list: single image, carousel, video, document, thought leader ads, lead gen forms, event ads (grade S: not fetched from the source page; verify before building for them).
not_stated: whether 9:16 video is mobile-only or how it is shown on desktop (page says nothing)
safe zones / UI overlay areas for captions
exact metric names in Campaign Manager for view / completion rates (verify in the account)

verified.source: https://www.linkedin.com/help/linkedin/answer/a1311816 (Video specifications for your LinkedIn Pages and Career Pages; page covers organic/non-paid video only)
